account: Today has mostly looked like ordinary town business during my market walk. Several townsfolk reported the baker carrying wheat at the bakery and bread at the market and inn. I saw the baker restock the bakery stall at 10:50. That seems consistent with baking, selling, or delivering bread; I have no evidence of anything improper. I heard a distant shout from the baker during lunch but could not understand it. A lantern appeared in the town hall at (-58,-60,31) at 10:53; I do not know who placed it or why. The secretary took the appointment book earlier and later said it was safe and the schedule unchanged. The secretary also investigated the location of my afternoon tea without verifying it. However, the neighbour personally confirmed tea at 15:00 at the east-bank cottage road point (16,-60,105). My attempted update to the secretary was not heard, so that clarification still needs conveying. I am now outside town hall at 13:16 for the scheduled town accounts appointment, slightly late after lunch and the attempted conversation. Freight is nearby walking, and the baker is near the stall holding an emerald, but I have not learned anything unusual about either activity.
